usage.ink: Primary dark background; primary text on paper.
usage.slate: Secondary/neutral UI, unmarked elements, muted labels.
usage.channelCyan: Accent only — one of the two clone/marker colors. Do not use as a general UI accent.
usage.channelMagenta: Accent only — the second clone/marker color. Always paired with channelCyan, never used alone as the sole accent.

roles.sans: Wordmark, headings, UI chrome. Weight 600 for headings/wordmark.
roles.serif: Running text — paper abstracts, group descriptions, publication-style copy.
roles.mono: Real data only: channel counts, coordinates, sample IDs, hex codes. Never decorative labels.

logo.minSize: 24px — below this, use favicon.svg (cluster-only stamp) instead of the full mark
logo.clearSpace: 1 cell radius (14px at the 240px reference size) on all sides
logo.backgroundRule: mark-color.svg and wordmark-lockup.svg are drawn for light/paper backgrounds. On dark/ink backgrounds, use mark-mono-paper.svg.
doNot: Rotate or mirror the lattice — it must stay orthogonal
Add a drop shadow, gradient, or glow to the mark
Pair the mark with unrelated science iconography (DNA helices, beakers, microscopes)
